text:
Sorry your plant arrived damaged. Because it was delivered 3 days ago, it falls outside the **48-hour** window for Damaged on Arrival claims, so I can't offer the DOA replacement or refund.

You still have these options:

- **Plant Care Guarantee claim:** You're within the 30-day window (90 days if you're a Leafy Plus member and ordered while your membership was active). Go to "My Orders" and submit a claim with at least two photos, one of the whole plant and one close-up of the snapped stem. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days, and you don't need to send the plant back. The guarantee covers plants that die or decline significantly (losing more than a third of the leaves or stem, rot, or collapse). I can't promise a snapped stem will qualify on its own, so the outcome depends on the specialist's review.
- **Escalation:** If you think the damage happened in transit and you'd like the late report considered, I can escalate to a Support Lead to see whether an exception is possible. I can't promise one.
- **Care advice:** A Plant Care Specialist can advise for free on whether the plant can recover. Chat is available 9am-5pm Mon-Fri.

Would you like me to escalate this?
